summary.quote: This is a recap of a completed operating asset - not a ground-up development or lease-up story.
paragraphs: The Silver Springs 7-Eleven Travel Center is a newly constructed, fully operational, multi-tenant travel plaza serving the primary growth corridor east of Reno, Nevada. Situated at the critical intersection of USA Parkway and US-50, this mission-critical asset serves as essential infrastructure for regional travel and freight traffic supporting the rapidly expanding Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center (TRIC).

Representing an equity recapitalization of a completed, income-producing asset - not a ground-up development or lease-up play - this investment offers day-one stabilized cash flow. The property is anchored by a corporate-backed, 15-year 7-Eleven net lease and further diversified with a Guthrie's QSR and an on-site tavern/casino featuring high-margin gaming revenue participation.
summary.conclusion: This opportunity is structured for durability and tax-efficiency, providing long-term ownership with balance-sheet protection and strong after-tax economics.

cards.title: Financial Returns
cards.summary: Cash flow is highly resilient and diversified across national credit, food & beverage, and gaming revenue. Year-1 lease income features $995k from 7-Eleven, $250k from Guthrie's QSR, and $625k from DG Tavern/Gaming, supported by a conservative leverage structure.

cards.title: Property Overview
cards.summary: Newly constructed 7,321 SF multi-tenant travel plaza built on 10.5 acres designed specifically for large-vehicle circulation. The asset features a standalone convenience store, 16 canopied fuel pumps, 6 high-speed diesel pumps, a car wash, and dedicated tavern gaming facilities.

cards.title: Market Analysis
cards.summary: Located along the USA Parkway and U.S. Route 50 corridor, the gateway to Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center (TRIC). TRIC is home to over 100 corporations including the Tesla Gigafactory, Google, and Apple, drawing tens of thousands of daily commuters and freight logistics through this intersection.

paragraphs: DG Real Estate Partners (DGRE) is a commercial real estate development and operating sponsor led by Matt Dahlhauser and Stephen Galbraith. With over 40 years of combined industry experience, the firm specializes in retail, industrial, assisted living, self-storage, and residential projects.

DGRE brings deep construction and operational expertise to every project. Its operating affiliate, DGOC, has owned and operated multiple national-brand convenience stores, truck stops, and franchise restaurants, offering a vertically integrated approach to high-performing credit-tenant assets.

teamMembers.name: Matt Dahlhauser
teamMembers.title: Co-Founder / Principal
teamMembers.background: Matt Dahlhauser has been active in commercial development specializing in retail, storage, and industrial projects for over 20 years. He worked as a contractor and was head of commercial development in the southeast for Armstrong Development before starting his own company in the late 2000s, focusing on anchored shopping centers, mixed-use developments, and build-to-suit national tenant sites. He is a licensed contractor who has built every asset type in his career and holds a bachelor's degree in Building Construction from Georgia Tech.

teamMembers.name: Stephen Galbraith
teamMembers.title: Co-Founder / Principal
teamMembers.background: Stephen Galbraith has been active in real estate for over 20 years. He began in commercial brokerage selling grocery-anchored, drug, and discount-anchored shopping centers before transitioning into equity and debt brokerage for Easlan Capital of Atlanta. He moved into development at Easlan Capital in the mid-2000s and launched his own firm in the late 2000s, developing several commercial and residential projects. Stephen holds a bachelor's degree in marketing from Marshall University.
